name: halation
title: Halation
description: A red-orange halo round the bright parts of a picture, with film grain on top.

props.name: src
props.doc: Picture in public/ (used when no children are given).

props.name: strength
props.doc: How much glow is added back. 0 is off, 1 is a visible but gentle halo.

props.name: radius
props.doc: Reach of the tight halo in pixels (the wide one is 3.2 times that).

props.name: threshold
props.doc: How bright a pixel must be (linear) before it glows. Lower glows more of the picture.

props.name: tint
props.doc: The colour of the halo. Film halation is red-orange.

props.name: tintMix
props.doc: 0 glows in the highlight's own colour, 1 in the tint.

props.name: fadeIn
props.doc: Frames the glow takes to come on at the start.

props.name: push
props.doc: How far the picture pushes in over the shot (0.04 is 4 percent).
